+import sys
+import types
+
+import pytest
+import toolz
+from tlz import _build_tlz as builder
+
+
+def assert_bindings(module, before):
+    assert set(module.__dict__) == set(before)
+    for name, value in before.items():
+        assert module.__dict__[name] is value
+
+
+def target_module():
+    module = types.ModuleType('tlz.transaction')
+    module.__package__ = 'caller.package'
+    module.__file__ = 'caller.py'
+    module.__loader__ = object()
+    module.__spec__ = object()
+    module.keep = object()
+    module.alias = object()
+    module.first = object()
+    return module
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('error_type', [RuntimeError, KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit])
+def test_discovery_failure_restores_namespace(monkeypatch, error_type):
+    loader = builder.TlzLoader()
+    module = target_module()
+    before = dict(module.__dict__)
+    error = error_type('discovery failed')
+    external = types.ModuleType('transaction_external')
+
+    def discover(fullname):
+        assert fullname == 'tlz.transaction'
+        module.__dict__.clear()
+        module.__dict__.update({'__name__': fullname, 'introduced': object()})
+        monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, external.__name__, external)
+        raise error
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(loader, '_load_toolz', discover)
+    with pytest.raises(error_type) as caught:
+        loader.exec_module(module)
+    assert caught.value is error
+    assert_bindings(module, before)
+    assert sys.modules[external.__name__] is external
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('failure_stage', ['child_import', 'hash'])
+def test_late_failure_restores_only_target(monkeypatch, failure_stage):
+    loader = builder.TlzLoader()
+    module = target_module()
+    before = dict(module.__dict__)
+    fast = types.ModuleType('cytoolz.transaction', 'backend docs')
+    slow = types.ModuleType('toolz.transaction', 'slow docs')
+    fast.__package__ = fast.__name__
+    slow.__package__ = slow.__name__
+    fast.__file__ = 'fast.py'
+    slow.__file__ = 'slow.py'
+    fast.added = object()
+    fast.alias = object()
+    slow.alias = toolz.pipe
+    child = types.ModuleType('cytoolz.transaction.first')
+    child.__package__ = fast.__name__
+    fast.first = child
+    second = types.ModuleType('cytoolz.transaction.second')
+    second.__package__ = fast.__name__
+    fast.second = second
+    mirrored = types.ModuleType('tlz.transaction.first')
+    error = KeyboardInterrupt('late population failure')
+    side_effect = object()
+    calls = []
+
+    def fail():
+        assert module.first is mirrored
+        assert module.alias is toolz.pipe
+        assert module.__package__ == 'tlz.transaction'
+        assert module.__doc__ == 'backend docs'
+        assert module.__file__ == 'slow.py'
+        assert module.added is fast.added
+        fast.import_side_effect = side_effect
+        slow.import_side_effect = side_effect
+        raise error
+
+    class BadHash:
+        def __hash__(self):
+            fail()
+
+    if failure_stage == 'hash':
+        slow.second = BadHash()
+
+    def discover(fullname):
+        assert fullname == module.__name__
+        return {'cytoolz': fast, 'toolz': slow}
+
+    def import_child(fullname):
+        calls.append(fullname)
+        if fullname == mirrored.__name__:
+            monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, fullname, mirrored)
+            return mirrored
+        assert fullname == 'tlz.transaction.second'
+        fail()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(loader, '_load_toolz', discover)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(builder, 'import_module', import_child)

+    if failure_stage == 'child_import':

+    assert calls == expected_calls

+    assert fast.import_side_effect is side_effect
+    assert slow.import_side_effect is side_effect
+

+    assert module.keep is retained

+    assert module.__package__ == 'tlz.transaction'
+    assert module.__doc__ == (local_doc or 'backend docs')
+    assert module.__file__ == 'slow.py'
